summary: Reviewed final acceptance and timeout repair against actual A1-A6 implementation, 369 passing attempt-01 regressions, and 30 passing targeted repair tests. The successor reruns all regressions, two real source-first Codex investigations, a unanimous omitted-exception challenge and a separate clean control. The recovered exact slot-43 response remains explicitly labelled as prior live evidence.
findings: Final no-live probes replay both source prefixes exactly, exercise three/seven deferred proposals, and request only SOURCE_FIDELITY/STRUCTURED_CRITICISM. Invalid and absent formalizations cannot be certified by quoting a renderer message. The actual legacy-reservation integration regression passed; all unsupported proposals and original source versions remain retained.

Final replay probe additionally exposed encodable hypotheses deferred by legacy family reservation. Amended the final repair before execution: bounded assurance of those retained proposals, preserving registration and release limits; fresh fidelity/criticism only on the expanded sets. The six-attempt stop and 77-reservation cap are unchanged.

Reviewed final a7-encoding-repair-plan.md after attempt 05: an unsupported expression is explicitly unresolved and retained, while valid siblings continue. Twenty-one targeted tests pass. Exact attempt-05 manifests bind both prefixes; 23EC46 is replay-only and 24EC16 permits only missing fidelity/criticism. 62 consumed calls, 15 remaining under the unchanged increment ceiling. This is the final allowed attempt.

The four-attempt stop fired. Reviewed explicit a7-attack-repair-plan.md and the master-plan six-attempt revision; no quota or acceptance relaxation. Target component namespace, expected ID and signed-proposition diagnostics now reach the repair request. The original malformed attacks and unrelated propositions remain rejected.

Actual retained-response identity probe completed all 36 pairs and requested only STRUCTURED_CRITICISM live (the probe dispatched no model). A separate regression confirms an unrepaired reader failure remains a top-level unresolved finding; it passed.

Attempt 03 passed 376 tests but failed final criticism. Reviewed a7-criticism-repair-plan.md: exact manifest-verified replay plus only missing fresh criticism for 23EC46; 24EC16 and paired seeded challenge remain live. 53 calls consumed, 24 remain under the increment. Quote/reference validation remains strict; 24 targeted repair tests passed.

Attempt 02 passed 375 tests and exposed one stale positional command assertion. Both named allowance/recovery arguments are now checked; all four supervisor tests pass. No runtime or acceptance criterion was relaxed and no extra live calls were used.

The 36-call increment ceiling is enforced atomically against the persistent prior 41-call ledger; 43 have now been consumed, leaving 34 under this increment. Each run has its own cap and bounded fidelity batches; no pair is silently skipped.
23EC46 and 24EC16 cover different source problems; they remain development material, not independent test-law labels.
Live pipeline completion requires real inventory, fidelity and argument checks; unresolved legal meaning alone does not fail engineering acceptance.
The predeclared seeded defect must be detected while its clean control is retained; all-abstention cannot pass.
Frozen response ablations share actual source and responses but cannot rank equal-cost stochastic efficacy.
Repairs for monitoring callback failure, source-inventory omissions and unchanged candidate progress are recorded before the final run.

No model/effort superiority is inferred from a timeout. Pilot call timeout 300 seconds, search cap six candidates/five calls and batch cap 32 are explicit resource choices. Recovery exact-match validation, early inventory failure stop, full pair coverage and date-change monitoring have targeted tests.
Trust context is required for authenticated Codex calls and the historically sandbox-sensitive API regression. No new provider cost, bank data or external messages.
